description: Assemble one approval packet from product planning, bug-hunt, workplan, and preflight evidence.

lines.description: Product lines to include. Default: next six minor lines.

max_findings.description: Maximum bug-hunt findings to include. Default: 10, max: 25.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

pr_comment.description: Include a concise GitHub PR comment markdown artifact in the response.

website_prompt.description: Include website-update prompt text in the response.

name: projscan_evidence_pack
